functionalCoverage: S1: exact-approved repair with unrelated missing decisions is amber, counts unique relevant looks, and offers working review/example actions followed by automatic re-proposal; physical conflicts remain blocking.
S2: consumed change/recast/impact return parameters are removed; close/reload does not create another proposal; manual same-board reopening clears previous recast intent.
S3: named deliberate-word acknowledgements bind exact direction, reference, scope and revision; preserve valid pixel approvals; and cannot grant appearance approval.
S4: an exact current approved twin is preferred over a newer unapproved duplicate; stale scope and permission checks remain enforced.

Minimal default disclosure, plain titles, costumed landing, natural images/comparison slider, compact wall/repair/allocation and legacy presentation cleanup preserve consent, errors, data, accessibility and immutable records.
